facts.value: You are coming from abroad to us? Discover the diverse offerings for international students and researchers at Goethe University and shape your personal academic path.

With Goethe in the world: Whether it's a semester abroad, ERASMUS study, internship, or activity in research and teaching – a stay abroad opens many new opportunities and perspectives for your personal and professional development.
Goethe University lives internationality: As an international university, it is globally networked and maintains numerous international university partnerships.
Internationality shapes our research, our study programs, and our campus. In this respect, all members of Goethe University are international – regardless of their origin.
